# Giovanni Village Resort

> Luxury family and wildlife resort on 23 acres at 410, Kolar Road, Kalapani, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462042, India — on the edge of Ratapani Tiger Reserve. Forest-view rooms and suites (several with private plunge pools or open-to-sky bath tubs), a soft-touch swimming pool, Elysium Spa, farm-to-table dining from the on-site organic Royalton Farms, eleven event venues, and 20 on-site activities for children, families and couples.

- Official website: https://www.giovannivillage.com
- Reservations: +91 90390 37302 · reservations@giovannivillage.com
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=13511098936656763409 (23.0969459, 77.3991207)
- Check-in 2:00 PM · Check-out 11:00 AM

## Stay
- [Rooms & suites](https://www.giovannivillage.com/rooms): King Room (Pool and Garden View), King Room with Private Garden, Junior Suites with deck, private garden, open-to-sky bath tub or open-to-sky plunge pool, Master Suite with Open-to-Sky Bath Tub, Royal Suite with Plunge Pool and Private Garden. Family suites sleep up to 3 adults and 2 children.

## Activities for kids and families (all on-site)
- [Experiences](https://www.giovannivillage.com/experiences): Junior Chef Academy (supervised cooking for children), soft-touch swimming pool, open-air theatre with movies under the stars, cycling through the estate, manual scooters, croquet, badminton and Tennikoit, frisbee, board games library (Ludo, Snakes and Ladders, Tambola, Scrabble, Jenga, Carrom, Uno, Foosball, Modern Kanche), jhoolas (swings), lakeside fishing, fresh cow milking at 4:30 PM, Royalton Farms tour and farm breakfast, self-service barbecue, telescope dinner at Pihu rooftop restaurant, Giovanni factory visit, sunbathing by the pool, Elysium Spa.
- Ratapani Tiger Reserve safaris (morning and afternoon slots, pre-booking required) arranged by the concierge.

## Dining
- [Dining](https://www.giovannivillage.com/dining): Gourmet By The Woods, Pihu (rooftop, telescope dinners), Gazebo by the Lake, The Private Dining Room. Produce from the resort's own Royalton Farms.
- [Menus](https://www.giovannivillage.com/menus)

## Weddings & events
- [Weddings](https://www.giovannivillage.com/weddings), [Meetings & events](https://www.giovannivillage.com/events), [Venues](https://www.giovannivillage.com/venues): eleven venues for twenty to two thousand guests, including the pillarless Aria Grand hall and lakeside lawns.
